task.description: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF-02 Step 3b) hard gate on REQ-157's test coverage.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 REQ-157 acceptance criteria have real runnable test coverage, verified independently
The reported mutation-gap fix (field assertions on the 6 per-function denial tests) confirmed present and would actually catch a skipped capability check
Test isolation confirmed (async: true/false usage reasoned about correctly per TEST-DESIGNER's notes)

artifacts_reviewed: test/letflow/engine/lua/platform_test.exs (39 total cases across both files)
result.notes:
All 8 REQ-157 acceptance_criteria read directly from docs/requirements.yaml (not from the spec's paraphrase) and independently mapped to real, runnable tests:
1. closed-set enumeration (exactly 8 names, no more/fewer) -> platform_test.exs 'REQ-157: closed-set enumeration (AC1)', pairs(platform) enumeration test + single-Lua.set! source-guard regex test.
2. per-function denial test for each of the 6 gated functions -> 'REQ-157: per-function capability-denial tests, empty grant set (AC2)', one case per function (read_variable/write_variable/log/emit_event/get_instance_state/call_service).
3. structured denial fields (function, capability required, capabilities granted) -> asserted on all 6 AC2 cases plus the dedicated 'REQ-157: structured denial fields (AC3)' case.
4. call_service('X') without service:call:X -> 'REQ-157: call_service denial without any grant (AC4)'.
5. service:call:alpha grant does not authorise call_service('beta') -> 'REQ-157: call_service grant is parameterised, not blanket (AC5)', 2 cases (alpha passes gate/reaches stub, beta still denied with correct required/granted fields).
6. now/fail callable with empty capability set -> 'REQ-157: now and fail are callable with an empty capability set (AC6)', now returns cleanly with no raise at all, fail raises the stub's own explicit_fail (not a capability-shaped) exception.
7. moduledoc reproduces the capability matrix + now/fail rationale -> 'REQ-157: moduledoc content (AC7)', 3 cases reading Code.fetch_docs/1 on the real Platform moduledoc, verified the actual moduledoc text in lib/letflow/engine/lua/platform.ex contains the matrix table, the ungated rationale, and the binding statement verbatim.
8. mix test / mix compile --warnings-as-errors pass -> verified myself, see below (not asserted inside a test, matching REQ-151/152 convention, TEST-RUNNER's formal responsibility at Step 4).

Mutation-gap fix verified directly, not just trusted from TEST-DESIGNER's report: read the 6 AC2 test bodies in platform_test.exs and confirmed each now asserts exception.original[:function], [:capability_required], and [:capabilities_granted] against the exact matrix-row values (previously bare assert_raise per the spec's own account of the gap). Then independently re-ran the mutation myself rather than trusting the reported counts: edited lib/letflow/engine/lua/platform.ex's install/2 fold to skip Capabilities.check!/3 for write_variable only (`if row.name != :write_variable do Capabilities.check!(...) end`), ran `mix test test/letflow/engine/lua/capabilities_test.exs test/letflow/engine/lua/platform_test.exs` -> Result: 38/39 passed, with the sole failure being exactly the write_variable AC2 case (`exception.original[:capability_required]` observed nil, expected "variable:write"). This confirms the field assertions catch a skipped capability check that a bare assert_raise would have missed (the stub for write_variable, like all 6 gated stubs, also raises Lua.RuntimeException unconditionally on its own not-yet-implemented path). Reverted via `git checkout -- lib/letflow/engine/lua/platform.ex`; confirmed clean via `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` (empty output) and a byte-identical diff against a pre-mutation backup copy; re-ran the suite -> Result: 39 passed (clean).

Other standard checks: grep for TODO/:skip across test/specs/REQ-157.md and both test files returned no matches. grep for password/secret/api_key/connection-string patterns returned no matches in either test file. capabilities_test.exs is async: true (pure MapSet logic, no shared state, correctly isolated); platform_test.exs is async: false with every Application.put_env(:letflow, :lua_platform_time_source, ...) swap reverted via on_exit (verified directly in the 'the time source is injectable' describe block) -- correct given the shared, process-independent application-env state platform.now/0 reads. No test depends on another test's side effects or execution order; each denial test builds its own lua/grant fixture inline or via its own setup block. No wall-clock or unseeded-randomness dependence (FixedTimeSource uses a hardcoded ~U[2026-01-01 ...] literal, no DateTime.utc_now/0 or :rand in assertions).
